m: नि-√ गर्ह् Ā. -गर्हते, (prob.) to blame, censure, find fault with, Pāṇ. i, 4, 32, Kāś.; P. -गर्हयति, to disdain, despise (acc.), MBh. (v.l. वि-ग्˚).

a: निगृहीत — p. p. 1 Seized, arrested. --2 Restrained curbed, checked, subdued. --3 Attacked. --4 Defeated in argument, caught; भो निगृहीतोसि U. 4.

suppressing (the voice, opp. to उद्-ग्राभ, elevating), Pāṇ. iii, 3, 36, Vārtt. 3

of a partic. gift or oblation, Hcat.

a: निग्रंथनं — Killing, slaughter.

m: नि-√ ग्रह् P. Ā. -गृह्णाति, णीते (dat. inf. -ग्रभे, RV.), to hold down, lower, depress, RV.; TS.; KātyŚr.; to keep or hold back, draw near, attract, RV.; AV.; ŚBr. &c.; to seize, catch, hold, hold fast, stop, restrain, suppress, curb, tame, punish, Mn.; MBh. &c.; to contract, close (as the eyes), Mṛcch. ii, 13/14 Caus. -ग्राहयति, to cause to be apprehended or seized, Daś. : Caus. of Desid. -जिघृक्षयति (p. ˚षयत्), to cause any one to desire to overpower or excel, Bhaṭṭ.
a: निग्रह् — {c9c} P. 1 To keep or hold down, keep in check. --2 To curb, restrain, suppress, control; निगृह्य शोकं K. 25; स्वकं तेजो निगृह्य Pt. 3. 174; Bg. 2. 68, R. 5. 59, 14. 85. --3 To stop, obstruct; निगृहीतो बलाद द्वांरि Mb. --4 To punish, chastise; Ms. 8. 310; 9. 308. --5 To seize, catch, apprehend, lay hold of; तमार्यगृह्यं निगृहीतधेनुः R. 2. 33. --6 To close or contract (as eyes); माथुरोऽक्षिणी निगृह्य Mk. 2. --7 To subdue, conquer, overpower, प्रज्ञया निग्रहीतुं शक्यः Mu. 1; 1. 26. --8 To draw in, restrain; निगृह्यंतामभीशवः Ś. 1.

one who keeps back or prevents, BhP.

m: नि-˚ग्रह m. keeping down or back, restraining, binding, coercion, suppression, subjugation, Mn.; MBh. &c.
defeat, overthrow, destruction, Kāv.
seizing, catching, arresting, holding fast, MBh.; R. &c.
suppression of an illness i.e. healing, cure, Suśr.
confinement, imprisonment, any punishment or chastisement, Mn.; MBh.; R.; Pañc. &c. (वधनिग्र्˚, pain of death, Kathās.)
reprimand, blame, L.
aversion, ill-will, dislike, disgust, L.
anything for catching hold of, a handle (ifc. f(आ). ), Suśr.
a place or occasion for being caught hold of, (esp. in Nyāya phil.) an occasion for refutation, a weak point in an argument or fault in a syllogism (cf. -स्थान)
a boundary, limit, L.
N. of Śiva and Viṣṇu-Kṛṣṇa, MBh.
a: निग्रहः — 1 Keeping in check, restraint, curbing, subjection; as in इंद्रियनिग्रह Ms. 6. 92; Y. 1. 222; Bh. 1. 66, Bg. 6. 34. --2 Suppression, obstruction, putting down; Ms. 6. 71. --3 Overtaking, capturing, arresting; त्वन्निग्रहे तुवरगात्रि न मे प्रयत्नः Mk. 1. 22; Śi. 2. 88. --4 Confinement, imprisonment. --5 Defeat, overthrow, vanquishing. --6 Dispelling, destruction, removing; R. 9. 25, 15. 6; Ku. 5. 53. --7 Arresting of disease, cure. --8 Punishment (opp. अनुग्रह); निग्रहानुग्रहस्य कर्ता Pt. 1; निग्रहोऽप्ययमनुग्रहीकृतः R. 11. 90, 55; 12. 52, 63. --9 Rebuke, reprimand, blame. --10 Aver. sion, dislike, disgust. --11 (In Nyāya phil.) A flaw in an argument, a fault in a syllogism (by which a disputant is put down in argument); cf. Mu. 5. 10. --12 A handle. --13 A limit, boundary. --14 The Supreme being. --Comp. --स्थानं the reason of defeat, unfitness to be argued with, one of the 16 categories of the Naiyāyikas.

m: नि-˚ग्रहण mfn. holding down, suppressing (ifc.), Suśr.

a: निग्रहण — a. Holding back or down, suppressing. --णं 1 Subduing, suppression. --2 Capture, confinement. --3 Chastisement, punishment in general. --4 Defeat.
